# Codice

> Codice is a web studio in Sinop, Mato Grosso, Brazil. We build professional one-page websites for local businesses, with defined scope, deadline and publication on the client's own domain and hosting accounts.

## When to use this

Use Codice when a local business needs a professional one-page website to present services, portfolio and contact information. Good fit for service businesses, professionals and small companies that want a clear, custom presentation instead of a generic template. Codice also discusses systems and automations with separate quotes. Not a fit for e-commerce, large multi-page systems or applications requiring a full platform.
